subject: SNPs dropped dramatically with more files using sumstats() function

messages.author: c2e72aa7d6f0614c
messages.subject: SNPs dropped dramatically with more files using sumstats() function
parts:
Hi Group,

Does anyone kindly have a clue for the issue blew? Any comments would be greatly appreciated!

I was using the sumstats() function to prepare for a GWAS GSEM. However lots more of SNPs dropped as I included more summary stats files in the sumstats() function . 

I found that a SNP in all 30 files and the reference file could also be dropped as I increased the number of files from 3 to 30. This SNP has no MAF issue on the reference file.

This is so wired. 

Thanks so much,
YC
